frag_vfr_global_sidx.mp4.avgFps: The global sidx covers the whole file, so ffprobe 8.1.1 stops its header walk after the first moof and mdat (mov.c:9740-9746) and computes avg_frame_rate 60/1 from 30 of 140 samples. The app reads every moof and reports the full-file average 4200/149, which equals avgFromPts; avgFpsFfprobe still reproduces 60/1.

frag_vfr_dash.mp4.avgFps: Each fragment has its own sidx and the last one completes the index, so ffprobe 8.1.1 stops right after it and never parses the last moof: avg_frame_rate 30/1 comes from 120 of 140 samples. The app reads every moof and reports the full-file average 4200/149, which equals avgFromPts; avgFpsFfprobe still reproduces 30/1.
